title: Fix copy, deepcopy, and pickle failures on Parameter and Sentinel
answers: Why does copy.deepcopy fail on a Click Command or Option in Python 3.10?
How do I fix pickle or deepcopy errors with Sentinel or UNSET?
Can Click Option, Argument, or Parameter instances be pickled or deepcopied?
body:
Symptom: copy.deepcopy() on an Option, Argument, or Command fails on Python 3.10, or pickle.dumps() fails when serializing parameters.
Root cause: src/click/_utils.py:Sentinel is an Enum with object values lacking __deepcopy__ and using default Enum reduction.
Fix pattern: Implement __copy__ and __deepcopy__ returning self, and __reduce_ex__ returning getattr with the enum class and member name.
Constraints: Applies to singleton Enum classes where members must retain exact identity across copy and serialization; does not apply to stateful enums.
applies: Click Parameter, Option, and Command objects containing Sentinel defaults
says: Cloning command-line option definitions crashes when running on newer Python versions.
Cannot save and reload command configurations to disk using standard object serialization.
Duplicating argument and flag settings in memory throws an unexpected crash error.
Allow CLI command configurations to be copied safely when cloning background jobs.
Saving cached command-line parameters fails with serialization errors during background processing.
